Four Paths to Wisdom

Choose Your Oracle Method

Whether you trust spontaneity, deliberate intention, visual art, or personal memory — every path resolves to the same 64-hexagram wisdom tradition.

🔮

Coin Toss

A digital recreation of the classical three-coin method. Cast all six lines instantly or build them one at a time for a fully authentic reading experience.

✍️

Manual Input

Select each line by hand — solid, broken, or changing — for complete deliberate control. Mix manual and auto input to suit your intuition.

🌌

Fractal Oracle

Draw on the canvas and let generative fractal art — Flow Fields, Julia Sets, Mandelbrot, Ferns — translate your strokes into hexagram lines. Rarely repeats.

📷

Photo Oracle

Select any photo from your device. The app analyzes its color composition to generate a hexagram unique to that exact image — every photo tells a different story.

How It Works

Your Reading in Six Steps

From question to insight in minutes.

1

Prepare Your Space

Find a quiet moment. Hold your question clearly in mind — the more focused your intention, the more resonant the reading.

2

Choose Your Method

Coin Toss for spontaneity · Manual for deliberate control · Fractal for visual intuition · Photo for capturing a moment's energy.

3

Cast the Hexagram

Six lines are determined bottom to top. Each is Yin or Yang, and optionally changing — mirroring the flux of the present moment.

4

Read the Primary Hexagram

The name and description reflect the current situation — the inner condition, outer circumstance, and guiding theme.

5

Explore Changing Lines

Changing lines carry specific wisdom about movement, tension, and what demands your attention right now.

6

Discover the Second Hexagram

Changing lines flip to their opposites, revealing the evolved hexagram — the potential outcome and direction of transformation.
